namespace:index:Blueprint.description: A Namespace image blueprint: a named base image defined either by an inline Dockerfile or by a base image plus apt packages. Changing the spec updates the blueprint in place (CreateBlueprint upserts by name, so the blueprint never disappears while it is rebuilt); changing the name replaces it. Import with the blueprint name.

namespace:index:BuildkiteQueue.description: Namespace settings (egress policy, workload permissions, OpenTelemetry export) of an existing Buildkite queue. Adopt-style: the Namespace API can neither create nor delete queues, so create looks the queue up by name and applies ONLY the declared settings on top of what the queue already has (the API replaces the whole settings object, so undeclared settings are read first and sent back unchanged), failing if no such queue exists. The settings found at adoption are recorded in priorSettings and destroy restores them. Settings removed from the program later are left as the server has them. Header values the server redacts cannot be restored. Import with the queue ID.

cluster.description: The Buildkite cluster the queue belongs to.

egressPolicyTag.description: Tag of the EgressPolicy applied to jobs of the queue.

egressPolicyTag.description: Tag of the EgressPolicy applied to jobs of the queue.

namespace:index:EgressPolicy.description: A named egress policy (outbound network rules) referenced by tag from GithubProfile and BuildkiteQueue. Updates use the server revision for optimistic concurrency. If the tag already exists at create time the policy is adopted and overwritten with the declared spec ('adopted' is set to true). The Namespace API has no delete for egress policies: destroying this resource sets the policy to mode DISABLED with all rules, rulesets and allowed domains cleared, and removes it from Pulumi state; the tag itself remains on Namespace. Import with the policy tag.

additionalRulesets.description: Names of predefined rulesets to include.

adopted.description: True when the policy tag already existed at create time and was taken over.

deepPacketInspection.description: Enable deep packet inspection (required for header injection).

mode.description: Enforcement mode: DISABLED, ALLOW_ALL, ADVISORY (report only) or BLOCK.

revision.description: The server revision of the policy; changes on every update.

tag.description: The policy tag other resources reference. Changing it replaces the policy.

namespace:index:GithubProfile.description: A GitHub Actions runner profile on Namespace: machine shape, cache volumes, custom base image, network policy and access level used by 'runs-on: nscloud-<tag>' jobs. namespace:index:InstanceIngress.description: An ingress that exposes one port of a Namespace compute instance on an Internet-facing server name (CreateIngress / DeleteIngress). The API reports only an ingress's name, fqdn and description back, so port, backendIpAddress, httpMatchRules and wildcard cannot be refreshed: an imported ingress carries only instanceId and name, and the port and rules you declare are accepted without a replacement. Import with 'instanceId/ingressId', or 'region/instanceId/ingressId' for an instance outside the provider region.

namespace:index:getBlueprints.description: Lists the image blueprints of the current tenant.

namespace:index:getBuildkiteQueue.description: Reads the Namespace settings of one Buildkite queue, by queue ID or queue name.

queueId.description: The Namespace queue ID. Set exactly one of queueId and queueName.

queueName.description: The Buildkite queue name. Set exactly one of queueId and queueName.

cluster.description: The Buildkite cluster the queue belongs to.

egressPolicyTag.description: Tag of the egress policy applied to jobs of the queue.

openTelemetrySettings.description: OpenTelemetry export settings. Header values may be redacted by the API.

namespace:index:getBuildkiteQueues.description: Lists the Buildkite queues connected to Namespace, with their Namespace settings.

namespace:index:getEgressPolicies.description: Lists the egress policies of the current tenant.

namespace:index:getEgressPolicy.description: Reads one egress policy by tag.

deepPacketInspection.description: Whether deep packet inspection is enabled.

mode.description: Enforcement mode: DISABLED, ALLOW_ALL, ADVISORY or BLOCK.

revision.description: The server revision of the policy.

rules.description: Ordered rules of the policy. Secret inject values are redacted by the API.

namespace:index:getGithubJob.description: Reads one GitHub Actions job run on a Namespace runner by its GitHub job ID. Fails with "was not found" when Namespace has no such job. The runner and compute instance details the API also returns are not exposed.

jobId.description: GitHub job ID, the number in the job URL, as a decimal string.

namespace:index:getGithubJobs.description: Lists GitHub Actions jobs run on Namespace runners, optionally filtered. Job and run IDs are int64 values returned as decimal strings.

after.description: Only jobs after this RFC3339 time.

before.description: Only jobs before this RFC3339 time.

conclusion.description: Only jobs with this conclusion, for example success or failure.

maxJobs.description: Maximum jobs to return. Defaults to 500.

namespace:index:getGithubProfile.description: Reads one GitHub Actions runner profile, by profile ID or by tag. Returns the same fields as the GithubProfile resource reports on import.

profileId.description: The profile ID. Set exactly one of profileId and tag.

tag.description: The profile tag used in 'runs-on' labels. Set exactly one of profileId and tag.

accessLevel.description: Access level: ACCESS_LEVEL_PERMISSIVE, ACCESS_LEVEL_LIMITED or ACCESS_LEVEL_RESTRICTED.

builderMode.description: Docker builder mode: USE_REMOTE_BUILDER, USE_LOCAL_CACHE or NO_CACHING.

customRunnerImageSpec.description: A custom base image for runners, built by Namespace.

description.description: A human-readable description of the profile.

emoji.description: An emoji shown next to the profile in the dashboard.

experimentalFeatures.description: Experimental feature flags enabled on the profile.

imageRef.description: Reference of the built custom runner image.

imageStatus.description: Build status of the custom runner image: BUILDING, FAILED or READY.

instanceShape.description: The machine shape of runners using this profile.

lastBuildError.description: Error of the last failed image build, if any.

networkPolicy.description: Egress network policy applied to runners.

os.description: Runner image of the profile. Required: Namespace accepts ubuntu-20.04, ubuntu-22.04, ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-24.04-systemd or ubuntu-26.04 (not 'linux'; that is what the platform reports in instanceShape.os).

rebuildTrigger.description: Any string. Changing it triggers a rebuild of the custom runner image (RebuildProfileImage) during update. Requires customRunnerImageSpec.

tag.description: The profile tag used in 'runs-on' labels. Changing it replaces the profile.

updatedAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the last update.

version.description: The profile version; increments on every update.

namespace:index:getGithubProfiles.description: Lists the GitHub Actions runner profiles of the current tenant.

namespace:index:getInstance.description: Reads one Namespace compute instance by ID, including instances that run containers. Fails when the instance does not exist or has been destroyed.

region.description: Region the instance runs in, such as 'us' or 'eu'. Defaults to the provider region.

containerCount.description: Number of containers running on the instance.

ingressDomain.description: Domain under which exported ports are served.

labels.description: Labels attached to the instance, including system labels.

readyAt.description: RFC3339 time the instance became ready.

region.description: The region the instance was read from.

services.description: Service endpoints reported by the instance.

namespace:index:getInstanceIngress.description: Reads one ingress of an instance, by ingress ID or by name.

ingressId.description: The ingress ID. Set exactly one of ingressId and name.

name.description: The ingress name. Set exactly one of ingressId and name.

region.description: Region the instance runs in. Defaults to the provider region.

name.description: The ingress name.

region.description: The region the instance was read from.

namespace:index:getInstances.description: Lists Namespace compute instances in a region, optionally filtered by labels.

includeDestroyed.description: Also return instances that have already finished. Defaults to false.

labels.description: Only return instances carrying all of these labels.

region.description: Region to list, such as 'us' or 'eu'. Defaults to the provider region.

namespace:index:getRegistryDefaultPolicy.description: Reads the default expiration policy of the Namespace container registry.

defaultExpirationSeconds.description: Default time in seconds after which pushed images expire. Unset when the registry has none.

expirationEnforcement.description: EXPIRATION_ENFORCEMENT_ENFORCE or EXPIRATION_ENFORCEMENT_DO_NOT_ENFORCE. Unset when the registry has none.

namespace:index:getRegistryImage.description: Reads one image of the Namespace container registry by tag or digest. Fails with "was not found" when the image does not exist.

reference.description: Tag, or digest of the form sha256:<hash>.

expiresAt.description: RFC3339 expiry time, empty if none.

reference.description: The tag or digest that was looked up.

totalBytes.description: Total size in bytes, as a decimal string (int64).

namespace:index:getRegistryImages.description: Lists images in the Namespace container registry, optionally limited to one repository. Deleted images are excluded.

repository.description: Only return images of this repository.

namespace:index:getRegistryRepositories.description: Lists the repositories of the Namespace container registry.

namespace:index:getRegistryRepositoryPol.description: Reads the expiration policy of one container registry repository.

expirationEnforcement.description: EXPIRATION_ENFORCEMENT_ENFORCE or EXPIRATION_ENFORCEMENT_DO_NOT_ENFORCE. Unset when the repository has none.

expirationSeconds.description: Time in seconds after which images in the repository expire. Unset when the repository has none.

namespace:index:getRevokableToken.description: Reads the metadata of one revokable token, including revoked and expired ones. The bearer value is only returned when a token is created, so it is never part of the result.

name.description: The token name.

tenantId.description: The tenant the token belongs to.

namespace:index:getRevokableTokens.description: Lists the revokable tokens of the current tenant (metadata only, never bearer values).

includeRevoked.description: Also return revoked tokens. Defaults to false.

namespace:index:getSharedImage.description: Reads one shared registry image by its shared image ID.

digest.description: The digest of the shared image.

expiresAt.description: RFC3339 expiry. Unset for images shared indefinitely.

imageRef.description: The image reference the shared image is pulled from.

repository.description: The repository that contains the shared image.

suffix.description: The suffix given when the image was shared, if any.

namespace:index:getSharedImages.description: Lists the shared registry images of the current tenant.

repository.description: Only return images of this repository.

visibility.description: Only return PUBLIC or PARTNER shares.

namespace:index:getTenant.description: Reads one Namespace IAM tenant, by tenant ID or by the external account ID it is linked to. Returns the same fields as the Tenant resource reports on import.

externalAccountId.description: The external account ID the tenant is linked to. Set exactly one of tenantId and externalAccountId.

tenantId.description: The tenant ID. Set exactly one of tenantId and externalAccountId.

createdAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when the tenant was created.

creatorId.description: Opaque identifier of the creating user (deprecated upstream). Changing it replaces the tenant.

externalAccountId.description: Identifier of the matching account in your own system. Changing it replaces the tenant.

labels.description: Labels attached to the tenant. An update overwrites the full label set.

policies.description: Policies applied to the tenant. Some policies can only be set at creation; the API does not return policies for other tenants, so they are not refreshed from the server.

visibleName.description: Human-readable tenant name. Updates in place.

namespace:index:getTenantGroup.description: Reads one IAM tenant group by name, including the IDs of the tenants enrolled in it.

name.description: The group name.

enrolledTenantIds.description: IDs of the tenants currently enrolled in the group.

name.description: The group name. Changing it replaces the group.

policies.description: Policies applied to the group's tenants.

namespace:index:getTenantGroups.description: Lists the tenant groups of the current tenant.

namespace:index:getTenantMembers.description: Lists the members of the tenant the token belongs to. The API can list and remove members but not add them.

namespace:index:getTenantPolicies.description: Reads the policies of the tenant the token belongs to.

revision.description: Server revision of the policy set.

namespace:index:getTenants.description: Lists the Namespace IAM tenants visible to the configured token, optionally filtered by creator or external account.

creatorId.description: Only return tenants created by this identity.

externalAccountId.description: Only return tenants linked to this external account.

namespace:index:getUsage.description: Reads compute usage totals and a per-day breakdown for a date range. Counters are int64 values returned as decimal strings.

periodEnd.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

periodStart.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

region.description: Compute region to query. Defaults to the provider region.

namespace:index:getVaultObject.description: Reads one Namespace vault object by ID. The secret 'value' is only returned for revealable objects.

labels.description: Labels attached to the object, including system labels.

revealable.description: True when the API returned the value (only revealable objects expose it).

value.description: The decrypted secret value. Secret. Only set for revealable objects.

namespace:index:getVaultObjects.description: Lists Namespace vault objects (metadata only, never values), optionally filtered by labels.

labels.description: Only return objects carrying all of these labels.

namespace:index:getVolumes.description: Lists cache volumes and persistent volumes in a compute region.

region.description: Compute region to query. Defaults to the provider region.
